src/_data/site.json.description: Global site metadata file for Eleventy templates. Contains: name (Atelier Rita Tomforde), title, description, author, lang (de), and contact object with location details. Available in templates via {{ site.name }}, {{ site.title }}, etc.

src/_includes/base.njk.description: Base Nunjucks layout template for all pages. Contains HTML5 structure with lang="de", meta tags (charset, viewport, description, author), title with site.name fallback, CSS link using | url filter, includes for nav.njk and footer.njk partials, and {{ content | safe }} block for page content.
